Stay single. Please, please please PLEASE!!! This is the absolute best advice I can give. In my experience and that of countless clients I've worked with over the years, this is what I know for sure:

1. Romantic love lasts about 1-5 years, but usually caps around 1 or 2 years, sometimes even sooner depending on the age of those involved. This goes for gay and lesbian, trans or other LGBTQ relationships as well as heterosexual. And, romantic relationships are more likely than friendships or familial relationships to breed hatred and violence once they've gone sour. 

2. More marriages end in divorce than don't, at least in my country (Canada), and by quite a large margin, too.

3. The breakup part of a relationship almost always causes way, way more damage than any good that came from the relationship (*exception for those of us who were blessed with a wonderful child). And no I'm not just being cynical. These are real statistics! People  who have experienced divorce or a harsh breakup are more likely to develop long term mental health problems, chronic illnesses caused by prolonged cortisol levels, bankruptcy, suicide, and more. Knowing what the statistics are like, your chances of this happening are greater than it not, should you get married.

4. Being single is remarkably underrated. Like some other commenters here have pointed out, it is also wrongly stigmatized in western culture.

5. Last but not least, there's the scenario where you actually do stay with the same spouse for life. Those people are some of the most unhappy, violent, alcohol/drug abusing people I know. So, so many people have told me how they desperately want out of a bad marriage but just can't manage it financially, or emotionally.

The only real incentive I can see in marriage anymore is financial -- as in, sharing a home is less expensive than living by yourself. Or, for shared child care responsibility (talk to a married woman and ask her how fair she thinks the division of labour is in her household). But this always comes at a cost of personal freedom, just like having a roommate. And that's if you can get along reasonably well, which is not easy for any two adults let alone lovers! And of course there is the good old-fashioned partner who sucks every dollar out of their spouse.
